rows.en: Hmmmmm......
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. frd_yui_009 (male) / frd_yui_010 (female), her ending.

rows.en:
You're really racking your brain.
What's up, Hoshimura?

I can't come up with any good ideas...
At this rate, developing my own original
Valkyrie will stay a pipe dream...

A good idea, huh...
I know, why don't you take a walk
for a change of pace?

Ooh! Nice ideaaa!
Then I'll go take a little walk
to clear my head.
Enjoy your walk.

(Say what you like, Hoshimura's got talent.
Give her a little spark, and I bet she'll
come up with a good idea in no time.)

(I've gotta do what I can, too, to support
Hoshimura's dream of building
her own original Valkyrie.)

Hey hey hey hey hey!
I came up with a really great idea~!
What! That was fast!

But hey, nice going!
What kind of Valkyrie did you come up with?

Well, first, for a weapon, it gets a giant drill,
and then the arms go flying off like rockets!
Sounds strong, right?
(I'm not sure that's a Valkyrie anymore...)

All right! I'm gonna start building it right away~!
Oooh, I'm getting all fired up~!!

(Aaand Hoshimura's totally set on building it...
Once she gets like this, nobody can stop her.)
Yeahhh!! Let's do thiiis~!!

Affinity ending.
Filler for Hoshimura (female).
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate, translated literally as c12399/c13990 and c08095.

rows.en:
Affinity ending.
Filler for Hoshimura (male).

You're really racking your brain.
What's up, Yui?

A good idea, huh...
I know, why don't you take a walk
for a change of pace?

(Say what you like, Yui's got talent.
Give her a little spark, and I bet she'll
come up with a good idea in no time.)

(I've gotta do what I can, too, to support
Yui's dream of building
her own original Valkyrie.)
What! That was fast!

But hey, nice going!
What kind of Valkyrie did you come up with?

(Aaand Yui's totally set on building it...
Once she gets like this, nobody can stop her.)
(Maybe I'll stop by Silver Moon for some tea.)
(Hm? Isn't that Hoshimura...?)
Hey, Hoshimura!

Oh-ho? Well, if it isn't \p!
You've come at just the right moment.
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. (old-fashioned ja nai kai).

rows.en: The right moment?

So how about an elegant tea time
with yours truly?
Sure, I'd be glad to join you.
So anyway, you should've seen Yuuto's face...
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. Yuuto = Yuuto Kagura (bare given name).

rows.en:
Whoa, look how late it got
without me even noticing.
Shall we be off home, then?
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. (kaerimashou kai); as the end of c14284.

rows.en:
Thanks for keeping me company today.
See ya.

(I had fun chatting with Hoshimura too.
It was a nice change of pace.)
(Hm? Isn't that Yui...?)
Hey, Yui!
Sure, I'd be glad to join you.

(I had fun chatting with Yui too.
It was a nice change of pace.)

(The weather's nice today.
Perfect for a walk.)

Well now, if it ain't \p!
Whatcha doin' 'round these parts?
rows.notes: Hoshimura, both genders. Kansai-dialect line (konaina, donaishita) rendered folksy.

rows.en:
The weather's nice, so I'm taking a little walk.
What about you, Hoshimura?

I'm out for a walk too.
I figured some good idea for tinkering might
pop up, so I came out to clear my head.

I see.
Then shall we walk together?

Okay, okay!
Well then, shall we be off?

(Taking a walk and chatting with Hoshimura
like this isn't half bad.)
And then, Miyuki suddenly...
Wait, AAAAAAAAAH!!
Wh-what's wrong, Hoshimura?

I just came up with a great idea~!!
So I'm heading home for today!
Later!

Huh!
Oh, see ya, Hoshimura.

(When she suddenly screamed like that,
I thought something had happened...)

(The weather's nice today.
Perfect for a walk.)

The weather's nice, so I'm taking a little walk.
What about you, Yui?

(Taking a walk and chatting with Yui
like this isn't half bad.)
Wh-what's wrong, Yui?

Huh!
Oh, see you, Yui.

(When she suddenly screamed like that,
I thought something had happened...)

uncertain: c14698: Yui's Kansai-dialect line rendered with folksy English ('Whatcha doin' 'round these parts?').
c14645 / c14688: Yuu and Yuuto read as Yuu Akimizu and Yuuto Kagura (bare given names).
